name: B10-0424/2025 (ECR) – United response to recent Russian violations of the EU Member States’ airspace and critical infrastructure
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on a united response to recent Russian violations of the EU Member States’ airspace and critical infrastructure
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises Russia for sending drones and fighter jets into the airspace of Poland, Estonia, Romania and other countries, and for sabotage and cyberattacks across Europe. It asks the European Union and NATO to act together: build a "drone wall" along the eastern border, deploy the NATO "Eastern Sentry" mission quickly, set up a joint crisis team, and tighten sanctions, visa rules and rules on platforms like Telegram. This is a statement of demands, not a law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament demands joint air defence, a drone wall, faster crisis response and new sanctions.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, NATO, and people in frontline countries like Poland, Estonia and Romania.
- **What happens next:** The demands go to EU governments, the European Commission and NATO, which decide whether to act.
